allow: PowerShell($n = \(Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($n\) { node --version; npm --version; "node at: " + $n.Source } else { "node not found on PATH" })

PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'deno','bun','node','npm','python','py'\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "$c -> $\($g.Source\)" } else { "$c -> \(not found\)" } }; "--- winget node available? ---"; $w = Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($w\) { "winget present" } else { "no winget" })

PowerShell($env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","Machine"\) + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","User"\); $n = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($n\) { "node: " + \(node --version\) + " at " + $n.Source; "npm: " + \(npm --version\) } else { Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\nodejs\\node.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select FullName })
PowerShell($n = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($n\) { "node on PATH: " + \(node --version\) } else { "node NOT on default PATH in fresh shell" })
